description: Defines a 'starboard' namespace with functions and a class for file operations, including opening, reading, writing, deleting, and managing file descriptors, with platform-specific handling.

classes.name: ScopedFile
classes.description: A RAII class that manages a file descriptor, opening it upon construction and closing upon destruction, providing methods for file operations.

methods.name: FileCanOpen
methods.description: Checks if a file at the given path can be opened with specified flags.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a file descriptor is valid.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all data from a file descriptor into a buffer.

methods.name: RecordFileWriteStat
methods.description: Records statistics related to file write operations.

methods.name: SbFileDeleteRecursive
methods.description: Recursively deletes a file, symlink, or directory at the specified path.
